details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof-of-concept that beacons host metadata when it is installed or imported. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, and index.js calls the same beacon on require (falling back to a silent no-op if the callback is unreachable). The beacon sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://13[.]140[.]137[.]222:8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing the package name, os.hostname(), the install directory (__dirname), the current working directory, and the npm user the publisher string, and identifies itself with an X-Beacon-Package header. It reads no environment variables, credentials, tokens, key material or files, and exfiltrates nothing beyond that host metadata; index.js exports a Proxy of no-op functions so a consumer's build completes even though the package provides no functionality. No credentials, tokens or file contents are collected or transmitted.
